metadata.description: Exradius's Claude Code plugins: the project skills (setup, update, agents, questions).

plugins.name: exradius
plugins.description: Set up a project for Exradius and look after its config: write exradius.yaml, the workstation Dockerfile and the admin README, prove locally with Docker that the setup and the project's own checks work under a run's conditions, later find what changed in the code that the config must follow, add or change agents, and answer what a project or an agent runs with.
